title: A Jobless Shoemaker Took Over A Town Hall In A Costume 🥾
caption:
A shoemaker in a secondhand uniform took over a town hall 🥾
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. In 1906 an out-of-work shoemaker named Wilhelm Voigt put on a captain's uniform, commandeered a squad of soldiers, arrested the mayor of Köpenick and took the town's cash. He was caught about ten days later, became a folk hero and was pardoned by the Kaiser.
Would you have saluted him? 👇
first_comment: Moral of the story: people obey anyone in a uniform. Would you have followed orders? 🎖️👇
